title: The rehearsal is a build simulator
intention: The rehearsal reads a ticket as a build simulator: handed only the ticket's plan steps and a measured list of what exists and what does not, each step answers that it builds or that it stopped and what was missing.
why: The rehearsal exists to find what a builder would have to guess at before the expensive model builds. Measured 2026-10-29 on 7a31059daa23: its prompt was 57,870 chars, of which the ticket was 16,011, and across three passes most gaps were existence doubts (does this file exist?) or wording differences between reads, not missing plan content — the reader was judging fit to the process and guessing at the world. Akien: 'it doesn't need to fit in to our build process it just needs to say i got stopped here or xyz is missing' and 'we should be telling it what exists and what doesn't before hand.'
traces_to: Law 1 (the cheapest reader is spent finding what the plan leaves unsaid, not doubting what the machine can measure); Law 3 (existence is measured before the read, not guessed by the reader); the spanning intention CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-the-cheapest-reader-proves-a-ticket-before-it-is-built.md; I-a-ticket-is-a-plan-and-a-log.md (the ticket file IS the plan)
how: At cairn/machines/rehearsal: prompt.md opens 'You are a build simulator here to identify what's missing' and judges build steps only, never the process; render() hands the intention, falsifier and the plan steps (the ticket's live decisions; at FIXME, that FIXME's steps) plus a WHAT EXISTS section built before the read by extracting the paths and dotted modules the steps name and measuring each with look(); VOYAGE CRAFT, ALREADY LANDED, the chart packets and the charters leave the render; each node is {step, state: builds|stopped, missing, confidence} keyed by step id; the three-read diff keeps stopped and step-presence gaps and drops assumption_differs; looks_at leaves the schema and the post-read looker retires.
falsifier: Done when (measured at PROVED): render('7a31059daa23') carries no '# VOYAGE CRAFT', '# ALREADY LANDED', '# CHART' or '# CHARTER' heading and is under 15,000 chars (57,870 measured 2026-10-29); it carries '# WHAT EXISTS' listing each path and module the steps cite with present/absent as measured; a fixture plan missing a needed fact still yields a 'stopped' gap naming it; schema.json has no looks_at and no assumption_differs. Horizon: the next three tickets rehearsed after PROVED reach clean in at most 3 passes each. Wrong intent if those tickets rehearse dirtier for reasons a builder would also hit — the chart was the plan.
watchme: none, because the horizon is already readable on the record: every rehearsal writes CairnCommons/rehearsals/<id>-<stamp>.json through rehearse() in cairn/machines/rehearsal/rehearsal.py, and the pass count per ticket is the count of those files, so 'next three tickets clean in at most 3 passes' is a glob over that directory at the next three PROVED closes
children: none, because the build is one machine's edits at cairn/machines/rehearsal (rehearsal.py, schema.json, prompt.md, intention+why.json) plus its proofs, and the amendment to one spanning intention file

decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): A Haiku builder would ask, and the decisions answer: which decisions are plan steps (live, non-superseded, non-scoped; at a FIXME cursor, only those whose step is that 'FIXME <n>' plus the steps they name); what the WHAT EXISTS extractor matches (backticked or bare tokens containing '/' with a file extension or ending '/', and dotted python module names beginning 'cairn.' or 'skills.'), resolved with the existing look() over [repo, commons]; the new node shape ({step, state: builds|stopped, missing, confidence}); which gap kinds survive (stopped, step_absent, unlisted — assumes/assumption_differs/cannot_proceed fold into stopped); what happens to old rehearsal records (read as history, never re-validated); which proofs are rewritten vs retired. Each becomes a D-line at /chart before rehearsal.
